name: JCC Day Camps
description_short: Day camp run by the JCC of Greater New Haven in Woodbridge, CT. It runs in two 4-week sessions, Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 4 PM, and offers after-camp enrichment.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page does not give a year for the session dates. They were taken as 2027 because June 21 and July 19, 2027 fall on Mondays, and July 16 and August 13, 2027 fall on Fridays. This matches the Monday–Friday schedule, and the rates are still marked TBD. Confirm the year with the camp.
Prices are not published yet: 'RATES TBD. Stay Tuned!'
